thread:
Sam T: heads up — primary for the 00:00-04:00 UTC block just had an emergency and had to drop. I got the page but already close to unavailable for the window. Can anyone take primary or a solid deputy? we have scheduled maintenance for model-worker autoscaler at 01:30 UTC so might be noisy.

oncall-bot: Paging summary: alert group=llm-serving-high-latency, pages=3, severity=high. Link: https://pager.redwood/alerts/llm-serving-high-latency/3402 

Sam T: quick context — rollback guard still on the canary, but autoscaler jobs might create short spikes. customer impact: several 5xx spikes reported, some users in EU seeing timeouts. please check runbook before taking.

Meera K: I can take primary 00:30-03:30 UTC if that helps. can be primary, but I need a deputy for the first 30m while I finish a deploy.

Jordan: I can shadow 00:00-01:00 UTC (warm handoff) then switch to deputy 01:00-02:00. After that I have a hard stop.

Ashley: noted customer impact — scoreboard shows AcmePay and FinEdge have increased error rates. attaching quick traces.

Ashley: ```
# quick query
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/series?query=llm_request_errors%7Bregion%3D%22eu%22%7D&from=-60m" | jq '.[] | {customer: .labels.customer, p50: .p50, p95: .p95}'
```

Liam: I can step in as backup 02:00-04:00 but only if Meera starts at 00:30 — otherwise i'm out (timezone + family).

Sam T: ok proposed plan: Meera primary 00:30-03:30, Jordan deputy 00:30-01:30 (then Jordan -> Liam shadow swap at 01:30), Liam backup 02:00-04:00. That leaves 00:00-00:30 with no primary — who can cover first half hour?

Jordan: I can flip my start to 00:00 if Meera can push to 00:30? that's messy. alternative: I take 00:00-01:30 primary, Meera takes over 01:30-03:30, Liam backup 02:00-04:00 — works for my calendar.

Meera K: I can move earlier to 01:30 but not 00:00. if Jordan wants 00:00-01:30 primary that's fine with me. Jordan — do you want to be primary from 00:00?

Jordan: yes I can be primary 00:00-01:30. I'll follow runbook and disable the autoscaler job if spikes appear.

oncall-bot: AUTO: Incident created INC-2026-0456 (llm-serving-high-latency). Severity: High. Incident channel: #inc-llm-high-latency (created). Assigned: Jordan (primary), Meera (handover), Liam (backup).

Jordan: taking primary now. quick checklist: 1) mute noisy runbook alerts for autoscaler job 2) verify canary rollback guard 3) ensure fallback routing to smaller model is enabled.

Sam T: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/llm-serving/latency-spike — steps 1-7 cover hotfix and rollback. also see ephemeral commands at the bottom.

Meera K: thanks. Jordan — when you take primary, please post this in the incident channel: "primary oncall Jordan, will attempt autoscaler pause + model fallback, ETA 10m to reduce spike" — that helps customers.

Jordan: will do. posting now in #inc-llm-high-latency.

Jordan: (in #inc-llm-high-latency) Jordan: primary - pausing autoscaler job on eu-cluster now, enabling fallback routing to quantized-variant-v2, monitoring p95. ETA 10m.

Ashley: confirmed AcmePay 5xx rate dropped from 8% -> 2% after fallback enabled. please keep customer comms ready if regression returns.

Liam: standing by to take over at 02:00 if needed.

Sam T: quick handoff notes for Meera -> Liam: leave `model-routing` set to allow fallback, revert autoscaler pause only after p95 stable < 400ms for 15m, and update incident page with any config changes. also - leave remediation checklist in the incident thread.

Meera K: got it. I'll take the handoff 01:30 with a short summary: what we changed, logs to watch, and known customers to ping.

Jordan: FYI command used to pause job (eu cluster):
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale job autoscaler-eu --replicas=0
```

Jordan: also used `kubectl logs -f deployment/model-worker-eu -c inference | grep -E "ERROR|OOM|timeout"` to monitor.

Ashley: added customer comm draft to incident doc: "We're seeing transient latency due to autoscaler maintenance; mitigation in progress; will update in 15m." please edit as needed.

Sam T: thanks everyone. final reminder — if you take primary please update the oncall rota in the incident so paging escalations go to the correct person.

Meera K: I'll confirm handoff at 01:30 in the incident channel and add deputy notes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: set your oncall status with `/oncall me` so the rota reflects current primary.

Jordan: handoff to Meera done at 01:30 UTC — posted summary in #inc-llm-high-latency. p95 stabilized to 360ms after fallback. leaving notes for Liam.

Liam: taking over 02:00 UTC. thumbs up.

Ashley: monitoring continues. if anyone sees new spikes tag me and I'll open a customer bridge. :phone: :+1:

Sam T: closing this thread — plan traded, inc created, runbook followed. thanks for the quick swaps.

Jordan: thanks team. good teamwork. :clap:"
